power-bi-embedded-pause-idle.title: Pause the capacity when it is idle
power-bi-embedded-pause-idle.body: This estimate runs the Power BI Embedded capacity all month, but the customer said it sits idle for periods. Microsoft says pausing an A SKU capacity prevents you from being billed, so price only the hours it needs to run.

citation.source: Pause and start your Power BI Embedded A SKU capacity in the Azure portal
citation.quote: Pausing your capacity prevents you from being billed.

power-bi-embedded-viewer-licences.title: Employees who view need Power BI Pro or Premium Per User licences
power-bi-embedded-viewer-licences.body: This estimate prices only the Azure capacity. Microsoft says that with an A SKU, each person who views embedded content inside your own organisation needs a Power BI Pro or Premium Per User licence. For internal apps that licence cost can be larger than the capacity itself, so add it to the budget (or consider a Fabric F64 or larger capacity).

citation.source: Power BI Embedded capacity and SKUs
citation.quote: If you have a SKU smaller than F64 or an A SKU, then a Pro license or Premium Per User (PPU) is required for each user who will view the embedded content.
